business_problem: Informal Colombian small businesses often lack bank accounts and traditional credit histories, so banks cannot verify their creditworthiness and these entrepreneurs struggle to access formal growth financing.
solution_summary: Quipu is an AI-based financing platform built to underwrite informal Colombian microbusinesses that lack conventional banking histories. According to the story, Quipu ingests nontraditional operating signals from each business, including social media activity, inventory information and real-time financial transactions, then processes them with its creditworthiness algorithm to judge present performance and future potential rather than relying on past credit files. The platform has accumulated lending data since 2021, allowing it to return a credit decision within seconds and to tailor loan offers to what each entrepreneur needs. Quipu also extends the experience through Edubot, a WhatsApp tool that acts as "a CFO in your pocket" for day-to-day support. The resulting scores drive Quipu's own lending and are now being licensed to other lenders in Colombia to expand access to capital.

data_flow: Quipu collects nontraditional business signals from sources such as social media, inventory records and real-time financial transactions, processes those inputs with its AI credit-scoring algorithm, and uses the resulting score to make loan decisions within seconds. The same workflow now supports personalized loan offers, Edubot guidance on WhatsApp, and lender-facing scoring technology licensed to partners in Colombia.
business_outcome: Quipu has allocated $5 million, helped more than 26,000 Colombian entrepreneurs access financing, reports that borrowers increase income by 9% after getting a loan, and is beginning to license its scoring technology to other lenders in Colombia.
metrics: Its loans range from $100 to $5,000; the average is $300.
